description: Primitives without normals: the synthetic scan (indexed, 2 charts, seam vertices duplicated), a quad with an unlit material, and a quad with a morph target.

normals.why: No edge of the scan is sharper than the crease angle, so no vertex is split; seam vertices keep their own UV.

notes: Bounds are the generator's float32 positions through the node transforms.
The scan's triangles are wound clockwise seen from outside, as in every fixture scanBuilder makes: normals computed from the winding point inward.
